hook.text: Anxiety hitting hard? Use this sixty-second trick. It calms your nervous system instantly.
queries: person feeling anxious hands chest closeup
stressed person eyes closed deep breath

tips.text: First, the cold water trick. Splash icy water on your face. Or hold an ice cube in your hand for thirty seconds. This activates your dive reflex and slows your heart rate fast.
queries: person splashing cold water face bathroom
ice cube melting in hand closeup macro
cold water running tap sink closeup
calm face after cold water relieved

tips.text: Second, the five four three two one method. Name five things you see. Four you can touch. Three you hear. Two you smell. One you taste. This pulls you out of your head.
queries: person looking around room mindfully observing
hand touching different textures soft fabric

tips.text: Third, box breathing. Breathe in for four seconds. Hold for four. Exhale for four. Hold for four. Repeat for two minutes. Navy SEALs use this before combat.
queries: person breathing slowly eyes closed peaceful
close up nose inhaling deep slow

cta.text: Save this for the next anxiety wave. And follow for more natural calm tips that work.
